description_en: Enables the MySQL or HTTPS port for a specified ApsaraDB for ClickHouse cluster

kebab_example: aliyun clickhouse create-ports-for-click-house --db-cluster-id cc-bp108z124a8o70000 --port-type mysql_port --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2019-11-11 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreatePortsForClickHouse

parameters.help_en: The port type. The value must be \`mysql\_port\`

parameters.help_en: The region ID. Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/170875.html operation to query the available region IDs
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/170875.html接口查询地域ID
